outer_split: original user/ranking split, original per-layer caps
outer_masks: nested random subsets of all fixed-catalog unordered pairs; independent of directions and performance
inner_validation: separate user records and additional same-mode pair mask among outer-unmasked pairs; same masking fraction
final_fit: all outer training records after outer mask only
MovieLens_graph: training-record item co-occurrence only, including ties without reading their direction; masked pairs removed; inner graph rebuilt from inner training records
catalog: original fixed catalog and layers; no new-item or purely inductive-catalog claim
selection: mean NLL; ties choose first candidate, including zero
inference: paired split summaries; overlapping resplits not independent populations; Holm correction across all 90 NLL comparisons
